items.text:
Poor dokumentation.
Poorly explained systems.
Spend hours repairing a bigger ship than yours to find out you can never really make it yours and deal with a annoying startup screen each time you open nav console.
Doesn't understand that wasting time isn't gameplay and that QoL features are desperately needed to make this game appealing.
Buggy as hell which grows more apparent the longer you play and more ambitious your salvage projects.
It runs like absolute ass. Gets worse the longer you play then restart.
Feels disrespectful to the players time when you spend so much time on fixing up a ship or merging your ship and a wreck together to not have any way, literally none, to legitimize the acquisition. Seems backwards and contributes nothing. Explanation of the dev is they dont wonna introduce a system to not blow the legality out the water. Neither sensible nor fun and most of the community IS asking for a way to make it happen.
This game could be great if the dev would bother listening to what the community wants but despite the time i had this game, these issues I have most issue with have not been addressed and have been the reason I quit the first time in the hope they were addressed when I come back.
items.text_zh:
文档很差。
系统解释得很糟糕。
花几个小时修理一艘比你自己的更大的船，结果发现你永远无法真正把它变成你的，而且每次打开导航控制台都要应付一个烦人的启动画面。
不明白浪费时间并不是游戏玩法，而生活质量功能对于让这款游戏有吸引力是迫切需要的。
bug多得像地狱，而且你玩得越久、你的打捞项目越有野心，这一点就越明显。
运行起来烂得一塌糊涂。你玩得越久就越糟，然后就得重启。
当你花那么多时间修好一艘船，或者把你的船和一艘残骸合并在一起，却没有任何办法，字面意义上没有任何办法，让这次获取合法化时，感觉这是对玩家时间的侮辱。看起来本末倒置，而且毫无贡献。开发者的解释是他们不想引入一个系统，以免把合法性彻底冲垮。既不理智也不有趣，而且大多数社区成员都在要求一种让这件事成为可能的办法。
如果开发者愿意费心听听社区想要什么，这款游戏本可以很棒，但尽管我在这款游戏上花了那么多时间，我最在意的这些问题却没有得到解决，也正是我第一次退坑的原因，当时我希望等我回来时它们已经被处理了。
